name: Subdomain
description: The bounding box of a mpi subdomain. Stores internals and provides optimized functions for communications between workers. This class may not be used directly. Instead, Subdomains are appended automatically to the scene bodies when using mpy.mpirun

attributes.name: boundsMax
attributes.description: max corner of all bboxes of members; differs from effective domain bounds by the extra length (sweepLength)

attributes.name: boundsMin
attributes.description: min corner of all bboxes of members; differs from effective domain bounds by the extra length (sweepLength)

attributes.name: extraLength
attributes.description: verlet dist for the subdomain, added to bodies verletDist

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Whether this Shape will be highlighted when rendered.

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: Whether this Shape is rendered using color surfaces, or only wireframe (can still be overridden by global config of the renderer).

methods.name: boundOnAxis
methods.description: computes projected position of a bound in a certain direction

methods.name: centerOfMass
methods.description: returns center of mass of assigned bodies

methods.name: cleanIntersections
methods.description: makes sure that the ids in the current subdomain belong to the current subdomain

methods.name: completeSendBodies
methods.description: calls MPI_wait to complete the non blocking sends/recieves.

methods.name: countIntsWith
methods.description: returns for a body the count of interactions (real or virtual) with bodies from a certain subdomain, interactions with subdomains excluded. Third parameter (scene pointer) can be left to default (equivalent to O._sceneObj).

methods.name: filterIntersections
methods.description: clear intersections and mirror intersections of all non-interacting bodies.

methods.name: filteredInts
methods.description: return a copy of intersections or mirrorIntersections from which non-interacting bodies have been removed.

methods.name: getMirrorIntrs
methods.description: get mirrorIntersections from other subdomains

methods.name: getRankSize
methods.description: set subdomain ranks, used for communications -> merging, sending bodies etc.

methods.name: getStateBoundsValuesFromIds
methods.description: returns pos,vel,angVel,ori,bounds of listed bodies.

methods.name: getStateValues
methods.description: returns pos,vel,angVel,ori of bodies interacting with a given otherDomain, based on Subdomain.intersections.

methods.name: getStateValuesFromIds
methods.description: returns pos,vel,angVel,ori of listed bodies.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize subdomain variables as rank and buffer sizes, call this from each thread after scene distribution by master.

methods.name: medianFilterCPP
methods.description: cpp version of median filter, used for body reallocation operations.

methods.name: mergeOp
methods.description: merge with setting interactions

methods.name: migrateBodiesSend
methods.description: ids of body to be sent have their subdomain parameter reassigned, followed by sendBodies

methods.name: mpiIrecvStates
methods.description: mpi-Irecv states from another domain (non-blocking)

methods.name: mpiRecvStates
methods.description: mpi-recv states from another domain (blocking)

methods.name: mpiSendStates
methods.description: mpi-send states from current domain to another domain (blocking)

methods.name: mpiWaitReceived
methods.description: mpi-Wait states from another domain (upon return the buffer is set)

methods.name: receiveBodies
methods.description: Receive the bodies from MPI sender rank to MPI receiver rank

methods.name: sendBodies
methods.description: Copy the bodies from MPI sender rank to MPI receiver rank

methods.name: setIDstoSubdomain
methods.description: set list of ids to the subdomain.

methods.name: setMinMax
methods.description: returns bounding min-max based on members bounds. precondition: the members bounds have been dispatched already, else we re-use old values. Carefull if subdomain is not at the end of O.bodies.

methods.name: setStateBoundsValuesFromIds
methods.description: set pos,vel,angVel,ori,bounds from listed body ids and data.

methods.name: setStateValuesFromBuffer
methods.description: set pos,vel,angVel,ori from state buffer.

methods.name: setStateValuesFromIds
methods.description: set pos,vel,angVel,ori from listed body ids and data.

methods.name: splitBodiesToWorkers
methods.description: of true bodies in workers are erased and reassigned.

methods.name: updateLocalIds
methods.description: updates the ids in the subdomain id vector, if not eraseRemoteMastrer, body->subdomain in master are updated.

methods.name: updateNewMirrorIntrs
methods.description: update the mirrorIntersections of a specific subdomain
